LanguageData.LP_Starfall.label: meteor shower
LanguageData.LP_Starfall.description: Silver shooting stars streak across the night sky one after another. Meteorites will fall before dawn.
LanguageData.LP_Starfall.endMessage: The meteor shower has ended; the last few meteorites crashed down.
LanguageData.LP_WeaveSurge.label: Weave tide
LanguageData.LP_WeaveSurge.description: Colorful auroras hang in the sky and the Weave is at high tide: every ability cast has a 20% chance to trigger wild magic. Spellcasting classes gain extra adventurer XP each day.
LanguageData.LP_WeaveSurge.endMessage: The aurora has faded and the Weave is calm.
